propositions: Replace manual attempt scheduling in _pai_structured with one bounded Agent operation composing the S1 output-policy adapter while preserving full history and request budget

Implement a wire-context projection HistoryProcessor that includes failed responses on retry wire only when input_tokens + output_tokens + effective_max_tokens fits the model window, else omits response whole

Add concision-aware guard on prompted branch only that detects truncation (finish_reason or provider_details in {length, max_tokens}) and retries with concision instruction, keeping refusal/content_filter terminal
Combine request budget (ceil(effective_max_iter/2)) with output-retry allowance (structured.OUTPUT_RETRIES) in one UsageLimits with shared counter, no per-attempt reset
Raise ContextWindowExceededError when authoritative input alone exceeds window without shortening content
Preserve NativeOutput branch selection, shared bounded operation, bug-895c grammar fallback, and terminal truncation with pai_output.guard_capability()
